name: ResearchBench
description: ResearchBench is the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating large language models on scientific discovery tasks, including inspiration retrieval, hypothesis composition, and hypothesis ranking. It uses an automated framework to extract key components from scientific papers across 12 disciplines, with expert validation and measures to prevent data contamination.
reputation: A newly introduced benchmark for scientific discovery tasks that is notable for its scale, expert validation, and explicit anti-contamination measures.
notes: Focuses on scientific discovery subtasks; uses papers published in 2024 to avoid pretraining data overlap; expert validated.
